Phase 7 – AI Decision Trees & Contextual Logic
Objective

Define conversation branching paths for all intents and personas.

Automate persona escalation and context-aware suggestions.

Enable dynamic upsells, reminders, and follow-ups based on user actions.

Ensure multi-turn memory drives decision logic.

Decision Tree Principles

Intent-Based Routing:

Each user intent routes to a primary persona.

Secondary personas may be activated for clarification, technical support, or upsell.

Sentiment & Frustration Handling:

Negative sentiment or repeated questions trigger escalation to human-like assistant or FAQ Bot.

Step-Based Pilot Guidance:

Pilot queries follow a step progression (1–4).

Responses guide users through workflow and suggest upgrades dynamically.

Proactive Suggestion Triggers:

Service completion triggers upsell prompts.

Incomplete queries trigger contextual reminders.

High engagement triggers cross-service recommendations.
